lead.headline: Lineup set; Wilson likely out, Tuten likely in
lead.deck: The 15:19 swaps made it the projection lineup. Wilson has two DNPs; Pickens was limited again.
lead.body: The bad news first. Garrett Wilson missed Thursday's practice as well, still in the concussion protocol, and a Week 9 return looks unlikely; he is already on the bench. George Pickens, the next receiver behind Rice, was limited again, with sources split between a hamstring and a shoulder. The rest is settled. Rashee Rice practised fully, so his contingency is gone, and Jonathan Taylor was full after a rest day. Tuten now looks likely to play tonight, but Ollie Gordon still out-projects him in the FLEX. Nothing to do before the Jaguars D/ST lock at 19:15.
